title: Belok kiri, belok kanan
blurb: Directing the driver when the map gets it wrong.

notes.title: belok, terus, pusing
notes.body: Belok kiri / kanan — turn left / right. Jalan terus — go straight. Pusing balik — turn back round.

notes.title: depan tu, sini
notes.body: Pointing words do most of the work: depan tu (just ahead there), sini (here), sebelah kedai (next to the shop).

notes.title: ikut
notes.body: Ikut = follow, go by. Tak payah ikut Waze — no need to follow Waze. Ikut jalan dalam — take the back roads.

I think I've lost my ticket.
tr.Awak kat pintu depan ke pintu belakang?: Are you at the front gate or the back gate?
A red top. I'm in front of the lobby.
tr.Baru je pergi. Kena tunggu lima belas mi: It only just left. You'll have to wait fifteen minutes.
tr.Belum. Nak beli kat mana?: Not yet. Where do I buy one?
tr.Boleh berhenti kat bank kejap?: Can we stop at a bank for a moment?
Sure. But don't be too long.
Yes. I'm in front of the lobby.
tr.Guard tak bagi masuk. Macam mana?: The guard won't let me in. What now?
The back roads are badly jammed.
The back roads. The highway is jammed.
tr.Kena tukar bas dua kali. Okay ke?: You have to change buses twice. Is that okay?
tr.Lapangan terbang. Sempat tak?: The airport. Will we make it?
tr.Leceh la. LRT ada tak?: What a hassle. Is there an LRT?
tr.Lepas lampu isyarat, belok mana?: After the traffic lights, which way do I turn?
tr.Nak bayar macam mana?: How do you want to pay?
tr.Nak beli berapa tiket?: How many tickets do you want to buy?
tr.Nak berhenti kat mana?: Where do you want to stop?
tr.Nak ikut highway ke jalan dalam?: Shall I take the highway or the back roads?
tr.Nak masuk ikut pintu mana?: Which gate do you want to go in by?
The back gate. Near the lobby.
The back gate. The front gate is jammed.
My house is next to the shop.
tr.Saya dah terlepas simpang. Macam mana?: I've missed the turning. What now?
tr.Sempat tak sampai sebelum pukul sembilan: Will we make it before nine?
Not for long. Get out quickly.
I don't think so. The road is jammed.
Never mind, I'll walk to the front gate.
Never mind. You can U-turn just ahead.
The one next to the shop.

Turn left.
And then?

Here?

gist.why: Belok kiri … lepas tu … belok kanan.

read.why: Left or right? Pick one, then add what comes next.
Where to stop: berhenti kat sini.

dialogue.ms: Waze cakap jalan terus. Betul ke?
dialogue.en: Waze says go straight. Is that right?

dialogue.ms: Tak payah ikut Waze. Depan tu belok kiri.
dialogue.en: No need to follow Waze. Turn left just ahead.
Turn left. Okay. And then?
Go straight until the traffic lights.
After the traffic lights?

dialogue.ms: Belok kanan. Rumah saya sebelah kedai.
dialogue.en: Turn right. My house is next to the shop.
Is it here?

dialogue.ms: Belok sini. Okay, berhenti kat sini.
dialogue.en: Turn here. Okay, stop here.

options: Next to a shop, right after the traffic lights
Before the traffic lights, on the left
gist.why: Lepas lampu isyarat … belok kanan. Rumah saya sebelah kedai.

listen.en: He is standing in front of that door.

dialogue.ms: Waze suruh masuk highway. Nak ikut ke?
dialogue.en: Waze says to get on the highway. Shall I follow it?

dialogue.ms: Tak payah. Highway jem teruk waktu macam ni. Ikut jalan dalam.
dialogue.en: No need. The highway is badly jammed at this hour. Take the back roads.
Okay. Which way do I turn up ahead?

dialogue.ms: Di persimpangan T, sila belok kiri.
dialogue.en: At the T-junction, please turn left.
Left. And then?

dialogue.ms: Jalan terus, lepas tu belok kanan kat lampu isyarat kedua.
dialogue.en: Go straight, then turn right at the second traffic lights.
Oh, have I missed it?

dialogue.ms: Ha'ah. Kita telah masuk ke simpang yang salah.
dialogue.en: Yep. We've gone down the wrong turning.
Sorry. Can I make a U-turn up ahead?

dialogue.ms: Bukan, lebih baik kamu kena pusing dan balik.
dialogue.en: No, you'd better turn around and go back.
Okay, turning back.

dialogue.ms: Belok sini. Okay, berhenti. Dah sampai.
dialogue.en: Turn here. Okay, stop. We're here.

gist.q: What went wrong on the way?
options: She missed the turn and had to go back
They got stuck on the highway
Waze sent them to the wrong house
gist.why: Saya dah terlepas ke? … Kita telah masuk ke simpang yang salah.
